title: Qatar seeks UN inspections of Iran's bombed nuclear sites to reopen Hormuz
note: The Guardian reports Qatar, the lead mediator, is urging Iran to admit UN inspectors to bombed nuclear sites, including those holding highly enriched uranium, with no commitment to remove the stockpile.
